entry_points.text: Tree bringup checks layout, creates zeroing node cache with fatal failure handling and drains dead reserves; fault setup publishes controls and subscribes a notifier with cleanup on failure and orderly teardown.

Test module seeds randomness and runs plain cached and augmented trials then fails load to unload; tracker debug starts in two stages with reap work; hash uses deferred workers; debug open binds single show with seq helpers.

exports.text: Radix trees offer insert with conflict check, slot replace, delete by key or iterator, slot lookup, tag set clear, chunk and gang scans, plus tree and identifier preload and teardown.

Balanced trees offer plain and augmented insert repair, standalone and wrapper erase with linked form, successor predecessor and postorder walkers returning absent at ends, and plain plus ordered replacement.
Indexed arrays offer guarded load and mark set query; counters offer conditional decrement and decrement with lock acquisition; hash tables expose table and bucket held queries.

Tracking offers stats, directory rendering and idempotent ordered debug publication under owner readable names; depot offers deduplicating save and fetch with print; plus random fill with reseed and rate decision.

hazards.text: Marker data and overwrite are fatal misuse and conflict; out of range tag set is a programming error while clear reports absent.
Only ordered replacement suits concurrent readers; double free warns with diagnostics without further mutation; corrupt depot handles warn and return null.
Some helpers were not routed and are assumed by contract only: printing, random seeding, allocation, read side guards and stack capture.

invariants.text: Roots encode allocation context and tag presence; growth builds missing levels with counts; placement publishes into empty slots; teardown frees interior nodes requiring empty aux lists.
Valid trees keep sorted order, forbid red child of red, keep uniform dark height with height bound; augmentation caches subtree maxima with eager ancestor raise; repair keeps deficiency short by one.

Saturation pins with classified warning and continues; combined decrement avoids locking when references remain and revalidates under lock; slow paths park dead and saturated, leaking on overcount and warning on imbalance.

Rendering stays silent when empty and reports allocation failure; depot hashes full traces, avoids duplicates under lock, truncates long traces and validates handles; mark query descends to a real entry.

Hash stays power of two with clamped shrink; resize migrates to a future table while lookups span both, then publishes after grace; callers separate retry from errors; benchmark uses bounded regions with split timing and warns on mismatch.

locks.text: Preload reserves serialize on a per processor lock with allocation outside; tree preloads return holding it on success and refill fails without it; identifier preload holds it even on failure; nonblocking reserve warns.

Print takes directory lock interrupt safe; debug reads validate under array lock then take it; depot insert takes pool lock with trylock only when constrained; resize holds table mutex with per bucket locks.

state_machines.text: Iteration couples current and resume keys with filter and anchor, handles empty and singleton specially, skips gaps and ends on wrap with retry needing restart; limiting uses init flag window allowance and miss count with reset on expiry and disabled or deny modes.

Insert keeps a red subject, ends on black parentage, ascends past red uncles, converts inner cases then resolves outer by rotation with recolor and notice; delete reddens black siblings, propagates deficiency or resolves by rotations, mirrored.

Alloc inserts with stack or bumps fallback, free quarantines and retires oldest when full, teardown drains and reports leaks; depot installs pools under limit retaining surplus; hash cycles steady pending migrating published rearmed.

structs.text: Tracker record with list anchor liveness and stack handles, directory stats with per stack counts, output sink with prefix buffer and sequential target, nested hash level union, and power fault descriptor with notifier block.

Reserve is twice depth minus one; identifier width omits sign bit; retry markers alias; stacks capture sixteen entries with one kilobyte buffer; hash defaults sixty four floor four; regions max thirty two over six capacities.
